# a bucket takes the fluid under the player; the creative bucket stays an empty one while a water bucket joins it
ADV Water items:bucket/any c
ADV Water items:bucket/water c
ADV Water items:inventory/any c
ADV Water minecraft:recipes/brewing/cauldron has_water_bucket
ADV Water minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
I Water 0 minecraft:water_bucket*1
STAT Water minecraft.custom:minecraft.play_time 4
STAT Water minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death 4
STAT Water minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_rest 4
STAT Water minecraft.custom:minecraft.total_world_time 4
STAT Water minecraft.used:minecraft.bucket 1
